$comment: Sources catalog. SEED (Engine agent): only unit-definition sources relied on by data/units.json are listed here. The Data agent extends this with fuel-property and emission-factor sources. Every non-exact data value must reference a source id here (enforced by validate-data.ts). ids are kebab-case.

sources.title: Universal Converter — Conversion Rules (docs/conversion-rules.md)
sources.reliability: Normative project rulebook; cites the definitional conventions (IT calorie/BTU, toe/tce/boe, therm, Julian year) used by v0.1. Placeholder citation to be upgraded to the primary external source by the Data/Research agent.
sources.notes: Used as the source_ref for standard_definition units whose primary external citation the Engine agent did not verify first-hand. NOT an external authority — it records the project's chosen convention and points at where the external citation belongs.

sources.title: Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI), NIST Special Publication 811
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
sources.reliability: Authoritative SI reference. Defines the exact factors for the pound (0.453 592 37 kg), US/imperial gallon, cubic foot, IT calorie (4.1868 J) and IT BTU. Citation added by the Engine agent for the factors it directly relies on; the Data agent may refine table/page references.
sources.notes: Appendix B lists exact conversion factors used here for lb, gallons, ft^3, cal_IT, BTU_IT.

sources.title: IEA / OECD Energy Statistics — unit conventions (toe, tce definitions)
sources.reliability: Defines the tonne of oil equivalent (1 toe = 41.868 GJ, net basis) and tonne of coal equivalent conventions used in international energy balances. Placeholder-strength citation; the Data/Research agent should attach the exact IEA glossary page.
sources.notes: toe = 41.868 GJ (10^7 kcal_IT net); tce = 29.3076 GJ are the widely-cited IEA/UN conventions.
